 Order
05.12.2025 Order No.
06. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement.
2. The Petitioner, by filing this Writ Petition, has made a prayer to quash the order dated 03.03.2025 passed by the learned District Judge-cum-1st MACT, Ganjam.

3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Opposite Party No.1 has filed an application under section 166 of M.V. Act claiming compensation due to the injuries sustained by the Opposite Party No.1 in a vehicular accident which took place on 19.04.2019 and the Opposite Party No.2 and the Petitioner were the Respondents in the Court below and stated the policy number in cause title of the claim application.

The Petitioner has filed a petition before the learned District Judge with a prayer to give direction for production of policy by the owner of the alleged offending vehicle as it is the statutory liability of the owner to produce insurance policy as per MV act.

sentences.text: Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the Petitioner and on going through the averments made in this Writ Petition, this Court set aside the order dated 03.03.2025 passed by the learned District Judge-cum-1st MACT, Ganjam.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition stands disposed of.
